details: Led development of a Node.js backend service handling millions of daily requests for FT web and mobile, transforming, caching, and serving images.
Collaborated closely with product and design teams to run small, data-driven experiments, rapidly iterating to improve developer and customer experience.
Mentored two engineers (senior and mid-level), setting objectives and supporting career development.
Managed deployments via AWS (ECS/Fargate, Docker) with CI/CD ensuring seamless releases.
Built Node.js CLI tools to automate developer pain points, adopted across multiple teams.
Led sprint planning and refinement, created Jira tickets, and collaborated with leadership on OKRs.
Worked on CornerShop, a live retail proof-of-concept in London blending digital innovation with in-store experiences.
Developed rapid prototypes using React, React Native, and Node.js to validate technical feasibility and user adoption.
Delivered fast-paced, greenfield solutions for global brands in a startup-style environment, driving ideation and experimentation.
